title: Piano players in New Orleans
summary: Punch names the few pianists he knew, such as Steve Lewis and Walter Pichon, and Willie Smith.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: That ain't full of front of them. Yeah. Did they have many solo piano players that you knew of? In them days?
Uh huh. Well, the piano players that I didn't know, they all were pretty much waiting for me.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

Yeah. Nobody stuff with stuff Now Steve, he was with P-Rone, and Robichardt a piano player at the Lyric Theater. And Miss Todd used to play with the Tuxedos. Well now they had a big band, but all the rest of them bands used with five pieces and you had no piano.
Well who were some of the piano players you knew then who were working alone or with

a singer? Well Mr. Todd, I know Steve Lewis with P-Rone, and Miss Kimball was with Robichardt, and his wife and his husband played trumpet, Kimball and Miss Kimball, and she played the piano. Well them was about the only ones I know, you know, piano players. They had guys used like Pichon, well he always had a job by himself in the clubs you know, Walter Pichon, you know him. Yeah.
I just wondered who some of the ones that were in the district here, you told me you worked
with them. Well there were a lot of them in the district, I didn't know the name, playing blues and things by themselves. There were lots of them around in there. Yeah.
You said you worked once with a piano player I think somewhere.
Oh yeah, at Toodleums? At Toodleums, yeah. Yeah, what I'm saying now, at Blues Phil.
Yeah, you don't remember his name by any chance.
Yeah, his name was Willie Smith, but he dead.
Yeah. Yeah, I worked with him there.
